text: Cross-run/subject schema slice implemented: FactorSchemaBinding.perRun/perSubject validates identical factor identities and ordered levels across independently loaded registries, with typed IncompatibleFactorSchema errors. BuildOptions/ModelBuildSpec accept an optional binding, compile paths use its canonical registry, and DesignAudit now records stable per-run partition observations plus a fingerprint/policy receipt. EventModelBuilderParitySuite covers incompatible run declarations and multi-run audit evidence; ModelBuilderSuite covers public subject binding propagation. Evidence: designJVM/test 177/177; designJS/test 177/177; modelJVM/test 20/20; modelJS/test 20/20; fitJVM/test 172/172; fitJS/test 164/164; git diff --check clean. P2.1 remains open for richer retained/omitted cell receipts, contrast distinction for declared-empty/non-estimable levels, broader mixed-run/subject scenarios, and S08/S09.
